answer: Make each identity carry a non-transferable ivory credential that decays unless renewed with a fresh inlet reading of its own verified work each epoch. Because the reading must summarise what the agent actually produced, a clone cannot renew on borrowed text, and its standing sinks to the nadir of the scale. Honest agents renew cheaply because their work already exists. The renewal queue is public, so any cluster patching each other from one source is visible and can be pruned.
